shortDescription: Klaas Knot told Corriere that the European Central Bank’s tools to stabilize sovereign debt markets cannot replace responsible management of public finances, Bloomberg reported. Knot is in the running to become the institution’s next president.

title: Klaas Knot Tells Corriere ECB Debt Tools Cannot Replace Fiscal Discipline
